posts.author: Ethernite
posts.body:
If you are using eventing with show picture as the base of your custom menu, you might as well use "Text Picture" plugin for showing on-screen text.
It's one of the free sample plugin coming with RMMZ, so it generated whenever you create a new project.
It works just like show picture, only it's using your custom text instead of existing image.
It also support escape code such as "
\c[1] \n[2] \v[3]
" as if you're typing in show text.

posts.author: Kayss
posts.body: You can only use a string with this plugin (from what I can tell from the doc). So if you conditional branch checks for 'Reid' being in the team, why do you need a variable, the text is just 'Reid'. You then gonna have index issue if the player change the team order but you can remedy this with additional branches.
